text:
maya (FinOps): Heads-up — our EMEA GPU monthly forecast is showing a weird uplift for europe-west4 this billing period. Need a quick team-level allocation and whether any invoice credit applied.

ashish (Infra): Which export? invoice_lines_v2 or usage_raw? I saw a GC export with merged SKUs that threw off the mapping yesterday.

maya (FinOps): usage_raw. Query I ran:
```sql
SELECT project_id, sku_description, SUM(cost) as cost, SUM(usage_hours) as hours
FROM `billing.usage_raw`
WHERE invoice_month = '2026-03' AND region = 'europe-west4'
GROUP BY project_id, sku_description
ORDER BY cost DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

priya (CostOps): I ran that and found a migration job (proj: infra-mig-ew4) that used a mix of nvidia-a100 & t4 during 03/05-03/09. It created multiple short-lived spot instances which increased total GPU-hours due to retries. I'm uploading a small matrix.

jordan (Platform): That was part of the k8s node migration — we intentionally drained nodes and reprovisioned in ew4; some pods had adhesion to older PVs causing restarts. Tickets: PLAT-517.

ken (SRE): Noted: preemption spikes were high on 03/07. Eviction patterns logged here: https://logs.internal/evictions/2026-03-ew4

finance-bot: Invoice credit check: invoice_2026-03 shows no auto credits applied. Manual credits require finance approval.

maya (FinOps): Ok — sounds like we may ask for a vendor credit on grounds of excessive preemptions causing retries. But first we need a team-level breakdown and a request template. Priya — can you output CSV with (team, project_id, sku, hours, cost, peak_gpus_day)?

priya (CostOps): CSV done: gs://redwood-billing/exports/ew4-migration-2026-03.csv. Peak GPU day for infra-mig-ew4 was 96 GPUs on 2026-03-07.

ashish (Infra): For chargeback: infra-mig-ew4 is currently unowned in chargeback mapping. Jordan please confirm ownership if Platform picks it up; otherwise booking to infra ops pool.

jordan (Platform): Platform will take ownership for the migration window and then tag the project as platform:migration. I'll update the ownership mapping.

maya (FinOps): Great. Two deliverables: 1) Priya — formatted vendor-credit request draft (include preemption stats + cost delta) by EOD. 2) Jordan — update ownership mapping and tag projects by EOD. If vendor rejects credit we may reallocate to infra ops pool and adjust next month budgets.

priya (CostOps): Draft template saved: gs://redwood-billing/requests/ew4-credit-request-draft.md. I'll ping vendor-ops once we have Maya's sign-off.

maya (FinOps): Sounds good. I'll review the draft tomorrow morning. Thanks all. :pray:
